text.p: The average yield at the latest auction of six-month discount treasury bills rose to 59.90 percent from 58.99 percent at the last sale on November 26, a central bank statement said on Friday.
The results of Thursday's auction, compared to the last
issue of six-month discount T-bills, were as follows:
Amount sold 42.290 million UAH 9.636 million UAH
Actual amount raised 32.560 million UAH 7.446 million UAH
The central bank sold 422,903 T-bills, the bank's statement said. Of those, 406,635 were competitive and 16,268 were non-competitive bids.
The date of the next auction of six-month discount T-bills is unfixed.
The average yield at the latest auction of nine-month discount treasury bills rose to 58.54 percent from 58.51 percent at the last sale on November 26, a central bank statement said.
The results of Thursday's auction, compared to the last
issue of nine-month discount T-bills, were as follows:
Actual amount raised 61.452 million UAH 172,920 hryvnia
The central bank sold 883,578 T-bills, the bank's statement said. Of those, 883,505 were competitive and 73 were non-competitive bids.
The date of the next auction of nine-month discount T-bills is unfixed.
The average yield at the latest auction of 12-month discount treasury bills rose to 61.20 percent from 60.96 percent at the last sale on November 26, a central bank statement said.
The results of Thursday's auction, compared to the last issue of 12-month discount T-bills, were as follows:
The central bank sold 893 T-bills, the bank's statement said. Of those, 888 were competitive and 5 were non-competitive bids.
The date of the next auction of 12-month discount T-bills is unfixed.
